config.NextSeasonSeeds.name: Next season's seeds on day 28
config.NextSeasonSeeds.description: On the last day of spring, summer and fall, Pierre and JojaMart also sell the next season's seeds.
config.SprinklerUpgradeRecipes.name: Sprinkler upgrade recipes
config.SprinklerUpgradeRecipes.descripti: Craft a Quality Sprinkler from a Sprinkler, and an Iridium Sprinkler from a Quality Sprinkler. Note: each recipe you know counts toward Craft Master and Perfection.
config.SiloUpgrades.name: Silo upgrades
config.SiloUpgrades.description: Robin can upgrade a Silo to a Big Silo (500 hay), then to a Deluxe Silo (750 hay). Turning this off with upgraded silos on the farm leaves them without data.
building.bigSilo.name: Big Silo
building.bigSilo.description: A sturdier silo that stores up to 500 pieces of hay.
building.deluxeSilo.name: Deluxe Silo
building.deluxeSilo.description: A reinforced silo that stores up to 750 pieces of hay.
